blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Roger Asumbrado and Johna Calipay emerged as the big winners in the Cebu Tenpin Bowling Association (CETBA) Bowler of the Month October 2026 tournament mixed division last Saturday, October 31, at the SM City Cebu Bowling Center.
